serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
I barely managed to get on the bus…
As if out of spite, it was right on time instead of being 10, 15 minutes late.
That’s just my luck I guess…
While on the bus I will call Big Daddy.
You: Big Daddy, how are you doing?
Big Daddy: Alright, little one. I can hear noise on da other side. Where are you?
You: I’m on the bus. Admin sent me the place of the meeting and I’m on my way.
Big Daddy: That’s good to hear.
You: I don’t want it to sound bad, but… {{wi}}Are we really doing the right thing?
Big Daddy: Of course! It’s not da time to have second thoughts. Don’t be afraid and just go with da flow.
You: If you say so…
Big Daddy: I believe you will do the right thing. Just one picture. That’s all I’m asking for.
You: …
Big Daddy: Let’s end this call. Who knows who might be eavesdropping on us. Public transportation isn’t da best place to have a talk like that.
You: You are right…
Talking with Big Daddy didn’t really help.
I don’t know why, but the thought of the Admin going to jail, probably for the rest of his life because of me, makes me feel uncomfortable.
He was supposed to be that evil guy, but now that I know he is more in the gray area of doing things illegally, but not actually hurting anyone makes this very hard for me…
Maybe if I can’t talk it through with Big Daddy I should try talking with Admin?
I wish I could do it without putting myself in danger. Who knows what he would do if he discovers I’m there to expose him.
There’s no time left to think about it. I’m already here…
